home.whyTitle: Why a library, not one bloated app

whyItems.title: Focused tools
whyItems.body: Each app does one job — planning a date, settling shared expenses, keeping memories — without burying it in menus.

whyItems.title: Pick what fits
whyItems.body: Every couple is different. Install only the apps that match your relationship, skip the rest.

whyItems.title: Better together
whyItems.body: The apps share one design language and one account-free philosophy, so they feel like a family.

whyItems.title: Always growing
whyItems.body: New apps ship regularly. The library grows with your relationship.

faqItems.q: Is TheCoupleApp one app or several?
faqItems.a: Several. TheCoupleApp is a library of small, separate apps — each one solves a single problem for couples. You install only the ones that fit your relationship.

faqItems.q: How much do the apps cost?
faqItems.a: Every app is free to download. Some add an optional paid upgrade — Duet, for example, has an optional premium question library.

faqItems.q: Which devices do the apps run on?
faqItems.a: The apps are built for iOS and Android, and are listed on the App Store and Google Play as they launch.

faqItems.q: Do both partners need to install the app?
faqItems.a: For shared apps like Duet, yes — each partner answers on their own device, and the answers unlock for both.

faqItems.q: What languages is this site available in?
faqItems.a: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Hindi and Arabic. Use the language switcher in the footer to change it.

about.title: About TheCoupleApp
body: TheCoupleApp is an umbrella brand for a growing library of apps for couples. Instead of one app that tries to do everything, we ship many small ones — each solving one specific problem really well.
Communication, planning, memories, finances, wellness, fun: every area of a relationship deserves a tool that is simple enough to actually get used.
whoWeAreBody: TheCoupleApp is an independent project — not a venture-backed company or a large team. It exists because most relationship apps try to do everything at once and end up doing none of it well.
The whole library is built around one idea: an app should be opened, used for a couple of minutes, and closed. No feeds, no streaks to protect, no scores to chase.
whatWeDoBody: We design and publish small apps for couples, one problem at a time — communication, planning, memories, finances, wellness and fun. Each app ships with its own focused feature set instead of becoming a menu inside one large product.
Every app is free to download on iOS and Android, and some offer an optional paid upgrade. New apps join the library as they are ready.
